G1214.name: Demas
G1214.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G1214.brief: Companion of Paul who later deserted him
G1214.short: Demas was a companion of Paul who later deserted him because he loved the world.

G1216.name: Demetrius
G1216.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G1216.brief: Silversmith who opposed Paul in Ephesus
G1216.short: Demetrius, a silversmith in Ephesus, stirred up opposition against Paul because his preaching threatened the business of making shrines of Artemis.
